answer: A network can make sybil farms pay quadratically: each identity gets a verifiable delay function whose length equals its registration index in the epoch. The first identity solves a ten-second VDF; the hundredth grinds a thousand seconds on one core; the thousandth grinds ten thousand, so a farm of one thousand clones burns five thousand core-hours. The honest agent registers as a singleton, pays one ten-second proof, and never feels the curve: its atlas of reputation stays clean, its vine of referrals grows one link at a time, and its zenith costs no electricity. Only the attacker pays.
